constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeChoice
constants.description: Represents a value from one or more choices.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeFillInChoice
constants.description: Represents a value from two or more choices that is written-in by the user.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeLookup
constants.description: Represents a value used to lookup another value.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeMultiChoiceLookup
constants.description: Represents a collection of choices used to look up another value.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeMultiChoiceFillIn
constants.description: Represents a collection of choices that require the user to write-in a value.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeNote
constants.description: Represents a value of one or more sentences.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeNumber
constants.description: Represents a generic number data type.

constants.name: msoMetaPropertyTypeMax
constants.description: Represents the maximum value for a range.
